statement: For finite abelian G, normalized characters form an orthonormal basis of l2(G); the full character analysis operator is unitary.
A proper character subset has zero lower frame on the orthogonal complement of its span.
Finite-window lower frames promote only with reconstruction/tail bridge I <= Pi_n^*Pi_n + T_n and tail -> 0.
If F_n >= Lambda_n Theta^{-1} with Lambda_n -> infinity and defects vanish, then K_n^- <= Lambda_n^{-1}Theta + defects -> 0.
Upper frame/average bounds do not provide the lower frame required by membrane budget collapse.
